name: line-social-mcp
description: LINE (social): me, publish_text, publish_image, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endp

platform_mcp_line_channel_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_line_channel_access_token.description: Channel access token of the LINE Official Account's Messaging API channel (long-lived token from the LINE Developers Console, or a v2.1 token), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {channel access token}' (securitySchemes Bearer in https://github.com/line/line-openapi/blob/main/messaging-api.yml).

tools.name: me
tools.description: 'Get bot info' returns userId, basicId, premiumId, displayName, pictureUrl, chatMode and markAsReadMode of the Official Account.

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: PUBLISHES TO EVERY FRIEND: POST /v2/bot/message/broadcast {messages: [{type: 'text', text}]} 'Sends a message to multiple users at any time' - every user who added the Official Account receives it and each delivery counts against the plan's monthly message quota (409 when the quota is exhausted). The response body is empty ({}); the only identifier, the x-line-request-id response header, is not exposed, so `id` is the literal 'broadcast'. `reply_to` is ignored (a broadcast cannot reply). No X-Line-Retry-Key is sent, so a retried call can deliver twice.

tools.name: publish_image
tools.description: PUBLISHES TO EVERY FRIEND: broadcast of one image message {type: 'image', originalContentUrl, previewImageUrl} (both HTTPS URLs; JPEG/PNG; the first image_urls entry is used for both). Only the first image is sent and `text` is NOT sent (broadcast it separately with publish_text). Counts against the monthly message quota; `id` is the literal 'broadcast' because the request id travels only in a response header.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: 'Get user interaction statistics' of a broadcast or narrowcast: `post_id` is the request ID of that send (the x-line-request-id response header, visible in the LINE Developers Console or your own logs - publish_text cannot return it). Counts are top-level fields (delivered, unique_impression, unique_click; LINE returns null below 20); per-bubble `messages` and `clicks` stay under raw.
